scope: User-approved Python QQuickItem/ShaderEffect packed-texture compatibility probe only
decision: stop/defer adoption: rendering and retention supported, safe shutdown ownership unresolved

protocol.source: Python QQuickItem virtual textureProvider returning a Python QSGTextureProvider
protocol.allocation: QQuickWindow.createTextureFromImage in updatePaintNode; packed RGBA8888, nearest filtering, no atlas option
protocol.qrhi_endpoint: QRhiResourceUpdateBatch::uploadTexture canonical description overload (submission, not GPU completion)
protocol.attribution_clock: Unix wall time, not latency measurement
protocol.readback: known-color/nonblank and zero-alpha correctness controls, not presentation FPS

attempts.negative_result: AfterRenderingStage scheduled retirement did not run in the empty detached frame. It ran after the next binding, defeating reload; final destruction alone did not establish safe detach.
attempts.revision: Use an explicit request consumed afterSynchronizing, guarded against deleting a currently bound texture. Also persist actual native process terminal status instead of relying only on report existence.

errors: resident texture ownership was lost before explicit retirement
attempts.interpretation: The fourth texture wrapper was invalid at the scene-invalidation cleanup boundary and its destruction callback was not observed. This does not by itself prove a physical GPU leak or identify whether Qt deletion, binding ownership or wrapper invalidation caused the discrepancy. Safe ownership is NOT established.

host.thread_observation_limit: QQuickWidget's observed basic/offscreen path; not proof of a separate threaded render-loop path

warnings: ShaderEffect reported an unassigned texture provider during the intentional null-source detach; retained as diagnostic output

not_claimed: Product NativeFieldStore or native byte budget/eviction implementation
General safe Python/C++ texture ownership at scene teardown
App numerical/original-sampler fidelity or complete A0k certification
Multi-map, hardware device loss or threaded-render-loop acceptance
Physical VRAM, GPU completion or presentation latency
next_decision: Keep #64 open. A separately approved ownership investigation must explain the reloaded texture's invalid wrapper and missing destruction observation at Qt teardown. Do not integrate, spend the later implementation budget, add a C++ bridge, or weaken cleanup checks automatically.
